text:
```yaml
name: Mark and close stale issues and PRs

on:
  schedule:
    - cron: '30 1 * * *'
  workflow_dispatch:

jobs:
  stale:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/stale@v10
        with:
          repo-token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          stale-issue-message: |
            This issue has been automatically marked as stale because it has not had recent activity. It will be closed if no further activity occurs.
            
            If you believe this issue is still relevant, please leave a comment or update the status. Thank you for your contribution!
          stale-pr-message: |
            This pull request has been automatically marked as stale because it has not had recent activity. It will be closed if no further activity occurs.
            
            If you believe this PR is still relevant, please leave a comment or update the status. Thank you for your contribution!
          close-issue-message: |
            This issue was closed because it has been stale for 60 days with no activity.
            
            If you believe this issue is still relevant, please reopen it or create a new one. Thank you for your contribution!
          close-pr-message: |
            This pull request was closed because it has been stale for 60 days with no activity.
            
            If you believe this PR is still relevant, please reopen it or create a new one. Thank you for your contribution!
          days-before-stale: 90
          days-before-close: 60
          exempt-issue-labels: |
            lifecycle/frozen
            help-wanted
            good-first-issue
            pinned
          exempt-pr-labels: |
            lifecycle/frozen
            help-wanted
            good-first-issue
            pinned
          exempt-all-milestones: true
          exempt-all-assignees: true
          remove-stale-when-updated: true
```
